summary: Tested 8-step character creation wizard refactoring. Fixed backend bug where finalize endpoint failed for characters without virtue. All backend tests pass (10/10). Frontend UI correctly shows 7 steps for cultures without virtue and 8 steps for cultures with virtue.
seed_data_creation: Database pre-seeded with cultures, backgrounds, occupations, virtues
context_for_next_testing_agent: 8-step character creation wizard tested. Key findings: 1) Step indicator shows 8 steps for cultures WITH virtue (Hombres del lago, Hombres de Bree, Beornidas) and 7 steps for cultures WITHOUT virtue. 2) Virtue step correctly skipped for non-virtue cultures. 3) Equipment step shows automatic equipment based on Nivel de Vida (Frugal/Común/Próspero). 4) Details step shows traits from Background. 5) Fixed backend bug: finalize endpoint now uses draft.get('virtud_id') instead of draft['virtud_id'] to handle characters without virtue.
